scope.method: Read every definition, qualification, symbol and local ambiguity statement; compare route titles/specification and file availability for all routes, then inspect targeted body passages for suspected gaps. No claim that every linked chapter was freshly reread end-to-end. No new external factual claims or primary retrieval.

semantic_judgment: No material mathematical, unit, timing or financial-definition errors found within the stated concise/local-convention scope. State-space arbitrage is properly conditioned on market convention; atom-sensitive ES, expected versus utility risk premia, no-Ponzi versus TVC, incomplete markets, log versus simple changes, and exact versus approximate equality are appropriately distinguished. Symbols are explicitly overloaded locally. Two learning-route gaps require adjustment before acceptance.

findings.finding: Sole route v12-c04 treats likelihood and selected-observation factorization but does not teach statistical sufficiency or its conditional-law/factorization criterion. The entry promises a concept the linked chapter does not supply.
findings.evidence: Inspected v12-c04 body occurrences of statistic/factorization; these concern conditional likelihood and selection, not sufficiency. Accepted v13-c09 section4, lines54–59 defines sufficiency for finite action laws and proves conditional-law/likelihood-ratio equivalence.
findings.recommended_resolution: Add or replace route with v13-c09, and qualify route as a finite action-family illustration; retain v12-c04 only as general likelihood background.

findings.finding: Sole route v06-c04 teaches finite-date no-unpaid-terminal-debt and explicitly defers infinite-horizon conditions; it does not develop the defined indefinite rollover restriction.
findings.evidence: v06-c04 dated budgets, finite-T extension and final scope paragraph inspected. Newly accepted v14-c05 paragraph18 explicitly defines the candidate-SDF no-Ponzi restriction and distinguishes it from optimum terminal equality. v14-c06 debt section gives finite identity and terminal limit.
findings.recommended_resolution: Add accepted v14-c05 and/or v14-c06 as direct graduate route, retaining v06-c04 only as elementary finite-horizon precursor.

other_route_judgment: All 156 entries have available manuscript destinations; chapter-title matches are adequate as broad navigation except the two identified direct-learning gaps. Definitions are not represented as proofs. Future newly accepted subjects can extend coverage without invalidating this scoped guide.
